title: Compare Exchange Loops
goal: Update atomic state conditionally using a compare-and-swap loop.

sections.text: You will recognise retry loops from lock-free algorithms in C++ or Java. In Rust, compare-and-swap loops update atomic values based on their previous state.

sections.caption: compare_exchange_weak handles spurious failures inside loops.

sections.text: `compare_exchange_weak` may fail even when the atomic value equals the expected value. On architectures like ARM, this spurious failure allows cheaper CPU instructions.
Inside a retry loop, spurious failures are retried automatically. Outside a loop, use `compare_exchange` to avoid unnecessary retries.

sections.caption: compare_exchange only fails when values differ.

sections.text: Passing invalid memory orderings like `Ordering::Release` on a load will panic at runtime.

explanation: Update atomic state conditionally using a compare-and-swap loop.
